recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-42984 unless the work group separately reopens the broader question of whether instant should allow more than the currently specified fractional-second digit range.
issue_request: FHIR-42984 was Applied/Persuasive for FHIR-core datatypes. It reported that the instant prose and example format appeared to limit fractional seconds to milliseconds while the regex allowed more precision; the approved clarification was to keep sub-millisecond precision allowed and note that precision beyond milliseconds is optional.

Later FHIR-24564 changed the same row from timezone-offset to UTC-offset wording without altering the FHIR-42984 note.
